intermediate.detail: 4 mins warm-up • Side-to-side athletic bounds
steps: Bound laterally from your right foot to your left foot like a speed skater.
Swing your trailing leg behind you and touch the floor lightly if comfortable.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 4 minutes (45s work / 15s rest).
intermediate.mod: Step wide instead of bounding to make it low impact.
intermediate.mistake: Absorb each landing by bending your hip and knee.

intermediate.name: Curtsy Lunges + Squat Combo
intermediate.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps • Sculpts outer glutes & thighs
steps: Perform one bodyweight squat, then step your right foot diagonally behind your left leg into a curtsy lunge.
Return to center, squat again, and curtsy lunge with the left leg.
intermediate.mod: Omit the curtsy angle and step straight back into a reverse lunge if hips feel tight.
intermediate.mistake: Keep your hips facing forward during the curtsy step.

intermediate.name: Diamond / Close-Grip Push-Ups (Knees or Toes)
intermediate.detail: 3 sets × 10 reps • Firms back of arms & inner chest
steps: Place hands closer together under your chest (index fingers and thumbs close).
Lower your chest toward your hands while keeping elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Press back up smoothly.
intermediate.mod: Perform on your knees or against a countertop to keep form strict.
intermediate.mistake: Do not let your elbows flare out wide.

intermediate.name: Reverse Crunches & Flutter Kicks
intermediate.detail: 3 sets × 15 reps + 20s kicks • Lower ab focus
steps: Lie on your back with hands flat beside your hips and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Use your lower abs to curl your hips 2 inches off the mat toward your ribs, then lower slowly.
Follow with 20 seconds of small scissor flutter kicks with lower back pressed flat.
intermediate.mod: Keep knees bent throughout if straight-leg flutter kicks pull on your lower back.
intermediate.mistake: Never use momentum to swing your legs.

intermediate.name: Squat Hold Pulses & Full Cooldown
intermediate.detail: 3 sets × 30 seconds pulse + 3 mins stretch
steps: Sink into the bottom of a squat with chest lifted and pulse up and down 2 inches for 30 seconds.
Stand, shake legs out for 20 seconds, and repeat 3 times before stretching.
intermediate.mod: Do a half-depth squat hold against a wall.
intermediate.mistake: Keep weight in your heels, not your toes.

beginner.name: Incline Treadmill Brisk Walk
beginner.detail: 10 mins • Incline 4–6%, Speed 4.5–5.5 km/h
steps: Step onto the treadmill, clip on the safety key, and set incline to 4–6%.
Walk at a brisk, natural stride (4.5–5.5 km/h) swinging your arms naturally without holding the handrails.
Maintain steady nasal/mouth breathing for 10 minutes.
beginner.mod: Lower incline to 2% if calves feel tight at first.
beginner.mistake: Holding onto the top rails leans your body back and cuts calorie burn by 30%—swing your arms instead!

beginner.name: Leg Press Machine (or Goblet Squat)
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps • Moderate weight, 60s rest
steps: Sit in the leg press seat with your lower back and hips pressed flat against the pad.
Place feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the sled platform.
Release the safety bars, lower the platform slowly until knees are at 90 degrees, and press back up without locking your knees.
beginner.mod: Start with a light weight plate to master the groove first.
beginner.mistake: Never lock your knees completely straight at the top of a leg press.

beginner.name: Lat Pulldown Machine
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps • Pull bar smoothly to upper chest
beginner.muscles: Latissimus Dorsi (Back Width), Biceps & Rear Shoulders
steps: Sit tall with thighs snug under the knee pad and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lean back just 10 degrees, lift your chest, and pull the bar down to your upper chest by driving your elbows down toward your pockets.
Control the bar slowly all the way back up for a full stretch.
beginner.mod: Use a neutral-grip (palms facing each other) handle if your shoulders feel tight.
beginner.mistake: Never pull the bar behind your neck—always pull to your front upper chest.

beginner.name: Seated Chest Press Machine (or Dumbbell Press)
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps • Controlled press and slow return
steps: Adjust the seat height so the handles are aligned with the middle of your chest.
Sit with shoulder blades squeezed back against the pad and press the handles forward until arms are extended.
Take a full 2 seconds to lower the weight back to chest level.
beginner.mod: Machine chest press guides the path safely for beginners.
beginner.mistake: Don't let your shoulders shrug up toward your ears as you press.

beginner.name: Stationary Bike / Elliptical Finisher
beginner.detail: 12 mins steady pace • Keep heart rate in fat-burn zone
steps: Adjust the bike seat so your knee has a slight bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke (or step onto the elliptical).
Set resistance to a moderate level (4–6 out of 10) and pedal at a brisk 75–85 RPM.
Cool down at an easy pace for the final 2 minutes.
beginner.mod: Recumbent bike (with a backrest) is great if you want extra lower-back support.
beginner.mistake: Avoid setting resistance at zero and spinning wildly—light resistance burns more fat.

beginner.name: Rowing Machine or Elliptical Warm-Up
beginner.detail: 8 mins easy-to-moderate resistance
steps: Sit on the rower, strap feet in, and remember the sequence: Legs push first, then lean back slightly, then pull handle to lower ribs.
Return in reverse order: Arms extend first, torso hinges forward, then knees bend.
Row smoothly at 22–24 strokes per minute for 8 minutes.
beginner.mod: Use the cross-trainer elliptical if all rowing machines are busy.
beginner.mistake: Rowing is 60% leg drive—don't just pull with your arms!

beginner.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlifts (RDLs)
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps • Hinge at hips, keep back flat
steps: Stand tall holding a pair of dumbbells resting against the front of your thighs, knees softly bent.
Push your hips straight back toward the wall behind you while sliding the dumbbells down to mid-shin, keeping your spine flat.
Feel the stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward to stand tall.
beginner.mod: Practice the hip hinge with no weights first by tapping your hips back against a wall.
beginner.mistake: Never round your lower back—stop lowering as soon as your hips stop moving backward.

beginner.name: Seated Cable Row
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps • Squeeze shoulder blades together
steps: Sit tall on the cable row bench with knees slightly bent and chest proud.
Pull the V-handle into your lower ribs/belly button while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Extend arms back out slowly without letting the weight stack slam.
beginner.mod: Keep your torso stationary upright throughout the set.
beginner.mistake: Don't rock your lower back forward and backward to swing the weight.

beginner.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 10–12 reps • Press overhead with control
steps: Sit on an upright bench (80–90° back support) holding dumbbells at ear level with palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells overhead until arms are straight above your shoulders.
Lower slowly back to ear level over 2 seconds.
beginner.mod: Use a Shoulder Press Machine if stabilizing free dumbbells feels wobbly.
beginner.mistake: Keep your lower back pressed against the bench pad.

beginner.name: Incline Treadmill Cooldown Walk
beginner.detail: 10 mins steady walk + full-body stretch
steps: Walk at 4.5 km/h on a 4% incline for 8 minutes, then flat (0% incline) for 2 minutes to bring heart rate down.
Step off and stretch hamstrings, quads, and chest for 3 minutes.
beginner.mod: Sip water throughout your cooldown walk.
beginner.mistake: Never jump straight off a moving treadmill belt.

beginner.name: Recumbent / Upright Bike Warm-Up
beginner.detail: 8 mins progressive pace • Warm up knees & hips
steps: Start pedaling at level 3 resistance for 3 minutes, then increase to level 5 for 5 minutes.
Keep shoulders relaxed and knees tracking straight ahead.
beginner.mod: Zero impact on ankles and knees.
beginner.mistake: Check that the seat isn't too low, which can crowd the front of your knees.

beginner.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat (to Bench)
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps • Hold 1 dumbbell at chest
steps: Cup one end of a single dumbbell vertically against your collarbone like a goblet.
Stand in front of a flat gym bench, squat down until your glutes lightly touch the bench, and stand back up.
Keep your elbows tucked inside your knees.
beginner.mod: Touching the bench guarantees consistent, safe squat depth on every rep.
beginner.mistake: Don't let the dumbbell pull your chest forward.

beginner.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row (on Bench)
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps per arm •Supported back builder
steps: Place your left knee and left hand on a flat bench with your back flat like a tabletop.
Hold a dumbbell in your right hand and pull your elbow up and back toward your hip pocket.
Lower slowly and complete 12 reps before switching sides.
beginner.mod: Supporting yourself on the bench takes all strain off your lower back.
beginner.mistake: Pull the dumbbell toward your hip (like starting a lawnmower), not straight up to your shoulder.

beginner.name: Pec Deck / Machine Chest Fly & Rear Delt Fly
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps • Sculpts chest & posture
steps: Sit tall on the fly machine with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a wide hugging motion, pause 1 second, and return slowly.
beginner.mod: Keep a slight, soft bend in your elbows the entire time.
beginner.mistake: Don't let the handles pull your arms too far behind your torso.

beginner.name: Cable Tricep Pushdown + Dumbbell Curl Superset
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps each • Tones arms
steps: Stand at the cable station, pin your elbows to your ribs, and push the rope/bar down until arms are straight for 12 reps.
Immediately pick up light dumbbells and curl them up to your shoulders for 12 reps without swinging your body.
beginner.mod: Keep elbows glued to your sides on both exercises.
beginner.mistake: Swinging your torso takes the work away from your arms.

beginner.name: Cross-Trainer Elliptical Stride
beginner.detail: 8 mins warm-up • Push and pull moving handles
steps: Step onto the elliptical pedals and grip the moving handles.
Actively push and pull with your arms while striding smoothly for 8 minutes.
beginner.mod: Keep your heels flat on the pedals to engage your glutes more.
beginner.mistake: Avoid leaning your body weight onto the console.

beginner.name: Seated Leg Curl & Leg Extension Machines
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps each • Isolates front & back of thighs
steps: On the Seated Leg Curl, align the knee pivot with the machine hinge and curl your heels back underneath the seat for 12 reps.
On the Leg Extension, extend your legs smoothly until straight, pause 1 second at the top, and lower slowly.
beginner.mod: Great machine pair that requires zero balance coordination.
beginner.mistake: Control the lowering phase—never let the weight stack crash down.

beginner.name: Assisted Pull-Up / Dip Machine (or Lat Pulldown)
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 10 reps • Builds upper-body strength
steps: Set the counterweight pin on the Assisted Pull-Up machine (more weight = more help!).
Kneel on the pad, pull your chin up toward the bar, and lower slowly over 3 seconds.
beginner.mod: Remember: on an assisted machine, a heavier pin setting makes the exercise easier!
beginner.mistake: Keep your core tight and avoid kicking your legs.

beginner.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps • Light weight for shoulder shape
steps: Stand tall holding light dumbbells at your sides with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until your elbows reach shoulder height (forming a T shape).
Lower slowly back to your sides.
beginner.mod: Use light dumbbells (2–5 kg)—lateral raises are all about form, not heavy weight.
beginner.mistake: Don't shrug your traps up toward your ears.

beginner.name: Farmer's Carry Walk & Plank Core Finisher
beginner.detail: 3 sets × 40m walk + 30s plank
steps: Pick up two moderately heavy dumbbells, stand tall with shoulders pulled back, and walk slowly across the gym floor for 40 meters.
Set the weights down safely and hold a 30-second forearm plank.
beginner.mod: Walking while holding weights is one of the best functional fat-burning core exercises.
beginner.mistake: Keep your shoulders level and walk with proud posture.

intermediate.name: Rowing Machine Warm-Up
intermediate.detail: 5 mins • Progressive pace up to 26 strokes/min
steps: Row for 2 minutes at an easy 20 strokes/min, then build pace every minute up to a strong 26 strokes/min.
Focus on a powerful leg drive followed by a crisp handle pull to the lower ribs.
intermediate.mod: Keep damper setting between 4 and 6 (not 10) for smooth water-like resistance.
intermediate.mistake: Don't bend your knees on the return until the handle has passed over them.

intermediate.name: Barbell or Heavy Goblet Squats
intermediate.detail: 4 sets × 10 reps • Challenging weight, 75s rest
steps: Set the barbell in the squat rack at collarbone height (or hold a heavy dumbbell at your chest).
Take a deep breath into your belly, brace your core, and squat down until hip crease is parallel with your knees.
Drive hard out of the bottom while keeping your chest up.
intermediate.mod: Always set the safety spotter arms in the squat rack just below your bottom squat depth.
intermediate.mistake: Never let your lower back round (butt wink) at the bottom.

intermediate.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
intermediate.detail: 4 sets × 10–12 reps • Full stretch at bottom
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a 30-degree incline and kick the dumbbells up to shoulder level.
Press the dumbbells up over your upper chest, then lower slowly for 3 seconds until you feel a stretch across your chest.
intermediate.mod: A 30-degree incline is much friendlier on the shoulder joints than a steep 60-degree angle.
intermediate.mistake: Keep your feet planted firmly on the floor.

intermediate.name: Bent-Over Barbell / Dumbbell Rows
intermediate.detail: 4 sets × 10–12 reps • Strong core brace
intermediate.muscles: Lats, Rhomboids, Rear Delts & Lower Back
steps: Hinge forward at the hips to a 45-degree torso angle with a flat back and knees softly bent.
Pull the barbell or dumbbells into your lower stomach, squeezing your back for 1 second at the top.
Lower under control without jerking your torso.
intermediate.mod: Use chest-supported incline bench rows if your lower back feels fatigued.
intermediate.mistake: Keep your spine neutral—never round your back.

intermediate.name: HIIT Treadmill / Stairmaster Finisher
intermediate.detail: 12 mins • 40s fast effort / 20s easy recovery
steps: Alternate 40 seconds of brisk effort (fast incline walk, jog, or fast Stairmaster step) with 20 seconds of slow recovery.
Complete 10 rounds, then cool down for 2 minutes.
intermediate.mod: Incline power-walking intervals burn just as much fat as running with far less knee impact.
intermediate.mistake: Stand tall on the Stairmaster instead of leaning on the rails.

intermediate.name: Stairmaster Warm-Up
intermediate.detail: 6 mins moderate step speed
steps: Step onto the Stairmaster at level 5–7 and climb with full foot contact on each step for 6 minutes.
Use fingertips on the side rails only for balance.
intermediate.mod: Use an incline treadmill walk if the Stairmaster is occupied.
intermediate.mistake: Avoid taking tiny tiptoe steps—press through your whole heel.

intermediate.name: Trap-Bar or Barbell Deadlifts
intermediate.detail: 4 sets × 8–10 reps • Drive through heels
steps: Stand inside the hex trap-bar (or with shins 1 inch from the barbell), hinge hips down, and grip the handles.
Pull the slack out of the bar, flatten your back, and push the floor away with your legs to stand tall.
Hinge hips back first to lower the weight to the floor under control.
intermediate.mod: The hex trap-bar keeps the weight centered with your body and is much easier on the lower back.
intermediate.mistake: Never jerk the bar off the floor with a rounded spine.

intermediate.name: Assisted Pull-Ups / Heavy Lat Pulldowns
intermediate.detail: 4 sets × 10 reps • Controlled 3-second lowering
steps: Grip the pull-up bar or pulldown bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull your chest up to the bar by driving elbows down, then take a full 3 seconds to lower yourself to a dead hang stretch.
intermediate.mod: Slowing down the lowering (eccentric) phase builds strength and muscle tone rapidly.
intermediate.mistake: Avoid swinging your legs to generate momentum.

intermediate.name: Walking Dumbbell Lunges + Cable Face Pulls
intermediate.detail: 3 supersets × 12 reps each
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides and perform 12 walking lunges per leg.
Immediately walk to the cable station with a rope attachment at face height and pull the rope toward your forehead while rotating thumbs backward for 12 reps.
intermediate.mod: Face pulls bulletproof your shoulders and reverse desk-job slouching.
intermediate.mistake: Keep your ribs down during face pulls.

intermediate.name: Rowing / Assault Bike Intervals
intermediate.detail: 10 mins • 30s sprint / 30s easy pedaling
steps: Push hard for 30 seconds on the Assault AirBike or Rower, then cruise slowly for 30 seconds to catch your breath.
Repeat for 10 rounds.
intermediate.mod: Scale your sprint effort to an 8 out of 10 so you can finish all 10 rounds strong.
intermediate.mistake: Focus on deep belly breaths during the 30-second recovery.

intermediate.name: Dynamic Mobility & Kettlebell / Dumbbell Swings
intermediate.detail: 5 mins warm-up • Hip-hinge activation
steps: Perform 2 minutes of hip openers and world's greatest stretch.
Grab a moderate kettlebell or dumbbell and perform 3 sets of 15 crisp hip-hinge Russian swings to chest height.
intermediate.mod: Swings are a hip snap, not a front shoulder raise.
intermediate.mistake: Keep your back flat and snap your glutes at the top.

intermediate.name: Barbell / Dumbbell Hip Thrusts
intermediate.detail: 4 sets × 12 reps • 2-second squeeze at top
steps: Rest your upper back (just below shoulder blades) against a sturdy bench with a padded barbell or heavy dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is parallel to the floor, keeping your chin tucked.
Squeeze glutes hard for 2 seconds, then lower under control.
intermediate.mod: Use a thick foam bar pad or folded mat across your hips for comfort.
intermediate.mistake: Keep shins vertical at the top of the thrust.

intermediate.name: Seated Cable Row + Push-Up Superset
intermediate.detail: 4 sets × 12 reps each • Push-pull fat burn
steps: Perform 12 heavy seated cable rows with a 1-second squeeze at the ribs.
Step onto the floor and immediately perform 12 crisp push-ups before resting 60 seconds.
intermediate.mod: Pairing a pull movement with a push movement doubles workout density.
intermediate.mistake: Maintain tight plank alignment during the push-ups.

intermediate.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squats
intermediate.detail: 3 sets × 10 reps per leg • Hold dumbbells at sides
steps: Elevate your rear foot on a flat bench while holding dumbbells in both hands.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, then drive through your front heel to stand.
intermediate.mod: Lean your torso slightly forward (15°) to target the glutes even more.
intermediate.mistake: Don't let your front knee wobble inward.

intermediate.name: Hanging Knee Raises / Captain's Chair & Plank
intermediate.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps + 45s plank
steps: Support yourself on the Captain's Chair forearm pads (or hang from a bar) and curl your knees up toward your chest.
Lower slowly without swinging, then finish with a 45-second floor plank.
intermediate.mod: Curl your pelvis upward at the top to engage the abs rather than just lifting knees.
intermediate.mistake: Avoid swinging your legs.

intermediate.name: Incline Treadmill Jog / Power Walk Warm-Up
intermediate.detail: 6 mins • 3% incline brisk pace
steps: Start with 2 minutes of brisk incline walking, followed by 4 minutes of light jogging or power-walking at 3% incline.
intermediate.mod: Power-walking at a 6% incline is a great non-impact substitute for jogging.
intermediate.mistake: Keep shoulders relaxed and gaze forward.

intermediate.name: Leg Press + Calf Raise Superset
intermediate.detail: 4 sets × 12 leg press + 15 calf presses
steps: Complete 12 full-range reps on the Leg Press machine.
With legs nearly straight (soft knees), press through the balls of your feet for 15 calf raises on the sled edge.
intermediate.mod: Keep the safety catches engaged until you finish the calf raises.
intermediate.mistake: Never lock your knees completely during the calf presses.

intermediate.name: Arnold Dumbbell Shoulder Press
intermediate.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps • Full rotational shoulder press
steps: Start seated holding dumbbells at chin height with palms facing toward you.
As you press the weights overhead, rotate your wrists smoothly so palms face forward at the top.
Reverse the rotation on the way down.
intermediate.mod: Hits all three heads of the shoulder in one smooth movement.
intermediate.mistake: Control the weight—don't bounce out of the bottom.

intermediate.name: Cable Woodchoppers (High-to-Low)
intermediate.detail: 3 sets × 12 reps per side • Rotational core power
steps: Set a cable pulley near the top of the tower and stand sideways gripping the handle with both hands.
Pull the handle diagonally across your body toward your opposite knee while pivoting your back foot.
Complete 12 reps, then face the other way.
intermediate.mod: Keep your arms mostly straight and rotate from your torso and hips.
intermediate.mistake: Don't just bend your arms—turn your shoulders and waist.

intermediate.name: Kettlebell / Dumbbell Farmer's Carry & Cooldown
intermediate.detail: 3 sets × 50m walk + 3 mins stretch
steps: Grab a heavy pair of dumbbells or kettlebells and walk with tall, military posture for 50 meters.
Rest 45 seconds, repeat 3 times, and finish with a full-body cooldown stretch.
intermediate.mod: Breathe steadily through your nose while bracing your abs.
intermediate.mistake: Never let the weights pull your shoulders forward.
